question: An image API must quickly acknowledge uploads while processing can finish later. Traffic arrives in bursts, and processing workers may be unavailable briefly. Which architecture best decouples intake from processing?

options.text: Make the upload request wait synchronously for a larger worker instance to finish.
options.explanation: Tetap mengikat latency dan keberhasilan intake ke worker.

options.text: Send each task to a random worker over HTTP without persisting it.
options.explanation: Pekerjaan dapat hilang saat worker tidak tersedia.

options.text: Cache completed responses in CloudFront but keep all processing synchronous.
options.explanation: Cache hasil tidak menyediakan backlog untuk pekerjaan baru.

options.text: Store uploaded images in S3, enqueue object references in SQS, and let workers process the queue asynchronously.
options.explanation: S3 menyimpan payload, sementara SQS menahan pekerjaan sampai worker siap.

question: SQS workers usually need four minutes to process a job, but the queue visibility timeout is 30 seconds. Some jobs are received by another worker while the first worker is still processing them. Which change is most appropriate?

options.text: Set an appropriate visibility timeout, extend it for long jobs, and keep processing idempotent.
options.explanation: Pesan tidak terlalu cepat terlihat lagi; idempotency tetap penting saat retry terjadi.

options.text: Add a delivery delay to every new message but leave visibility at 30 seconds.
options.explanation: Delay awal tidak mengatasi redelivery saat pekerjaan sedang berjalan.

options.text: Delete each message immediately after receiving it, before processing succeeds.
options.explanation: Ini dapat kehilangan pekerjaan jika worker gagal setelah delete.

options.text: Increase only the message retention period from one day to seven days.
options.explanation: Retention tidak menentukan invisibility saat sedang diproses.

question: A small number of invalid messages repeatedly fail in an SQS standard queue. The team needs to isolate them for investigation after a limited number of receives while continuing normal processing. Which configuration fits?

options.text: Increase message retention only, without limiting the receives of repeatedly failing messages.
options.explanation: Retention lebih panjang menahan pesan lebih lama tetapi tidak memisahkan poison messages setelah jumlah kegagalan tertentu.

options.text: Increase the visibility timeout for the entire queue but never move repeatedly failing messages elsewhere.
options.explanation: Timeout lebih lama dapat menunda retry tetapi tidak membuat isolasi DLQ yang diminta.

options.text: Configure a dead-letter queue and a redrive policy with an appropriate maxReceiveCount.
options.explanation: Pesan bermasalah dipisah setelah batas percobaan yang ditetapkan.

options.text: Delete every message after its first failed processing attempt and keep no failure record.
options.explanation: Ini menghilangkan kesempatan retry/investigasi dan tidak memenuhi isolasi pesan gagal untuk diperiksa.

question: An order system must process updates in enqueue order for each customer account, while processing different accounts concurrently. Which SQS design best matches these requirements?

options.text: Use a FIFO queue with one MessageGroupId shared by every account.
options.explanation: Urutan terjaga tetapi seluruh akun diserialkan tanpa kebutuhan.

options.text: Use a new random MessageGroupId for every message from the same account.
options.explanation: Pesan satu akun tidak lagi berada dalam grup urutan yang sama.

options.text: Use a FIFO queue with the customer account ID as MessageGroupId.
options.explanation: Urutan dijaga per akun, sedangkan grup akun lain dapat berjalan paralel.

options.text: Use a standard queue and assume MessageGroupId enforces FIFO ordering.
options.explanation: MessageGroupId pada standard queue bukan jaminan urutan FIFO.

question: A worker charges a payment provider and then crashes before deleting its SQS message. The message is delivered again. Which design best prevents a second charge while still allowing recovery?

options.text: Generate a new payment idempotency key for every retry.
options.explanation: Key baru membuat retry tampak sebagai charge yang berbeda.

options.text: Delete every message before contacting the payment provider.
options.explanation: Crash setelah delete dapat membuat charge yang diperlukan tidak pernah dilakukan.

options.text: Switch to FIFO and assume a successful external charge can never be executed twice.
options.explanation: FIFO tidak mengatomikkan efek eksternal dengan delete pesan.

options.text: Use a stable business operation ID with the provider's idempotency feature and persist processing state safely.
options.explanation: Retry merujuk operasi bisnis yang sama, sehingga efek charge tidak harus diulang.

question: A producer retries SendMessage after a timeout. The team wants FIFO deduplication to recognize retries of the same business event within the supported deduplication interval. Which actions support this design? Select TWO.

options.text: Generate a new MessageDeduplicationId on every network retry.
options.explanation: ID baru menandai kiriman sebagai berbeda.

options.text: Use an SQS FIFO queue.
options.explanation: Deduplikasi kiriman yang dimaksud merupakan kemampuan FIFO.

options.text: Assume the deduplication window also makes all downstream database writes atomic.
options.explanation: Deduplikasi pengiriman tidak memberi transaksi lintas sistem.

options.text: Reuse a stable MessageDeduplicationId for retries of the same event.
options.explanation: ID yang sama menghubungkan kiriman ulang dengan event yang sama.

options.text: Use only a longer message retention period on a standard queue.
options.explanation: Retention bukan deduplication identifier.

question: Billing, email, and analytics services must each receive every order-created event. Each service needs its own backlog and retry pace. Which architecture meets these requirements?

options.text: Route each event to exactly one target using an ALB round-robin algorithm.
options.explanation: Load balancing satu target tidak menghasilkan fanout ke tiga layanan.

options.text: Call all services synchronously in series before accepting the order.
options.explanation: Semua layanan menjadi ketergantungan sinkron tanpa backlog mandiri.

options.text: Publish to SNS and subscribe a separate SQS queue for each service.
options.explanation: Setiap layanan menerima salinan melalui queue-nya sendiri dan tidak saling mengambil pekerjaan.

options.text: Let all three services poll one shared SQS queue.
options.explanation: Satu queue membagi pekerjaan, bukan menjamin semua layanan menerima tiap event.

question: A platform receives events from AWS services and supported SaaS integrations. It wants a central event bus with rules that route matching event content to different targets without custom polling code. Which design fits best?

options.text: Use Route 53 weighted DNS records to inspect event JSON fields.
options.explanation: DNS tidak memeriksa isi JSON event.

options.text: Use an ALB listener to periodically poll SaaS audit APIs.
options.explanation: ALB tidak menjadi integrator polling SaaS atau event bus.

options.text: Use one SQS queue and require every target to discard unrelated messages after receiving them.
options.explanation: Consumer dapat mengambil pesan yang dibutuhkan consumer lain; routing juga tidak terpusat.

options.text: Use EventBridge event buses and event-pattern rules with the required targets.
options.explanation: EventBridge menyediakan integrasi event dan routing berdasarkan isi.

question: An SNS topic must deliver order events into two SQS queues owned by the same team. The subscriptions exist, but the queue policies do not permit SNS delivery. Which changes preserve least privilege and independent processing? Select TWO.

options.text: Have each downstream service consume its own subscribed queue.
options.explanation: Queue terpisah mempertahankan backlog dan retry masing-masing.

options.text: Make both services compete for only one of the two queues.
options.explanation: Ini menghilangkan fanout independen ke semua layanan.

options.text: Replace the subscriptions with a single synchronous call to one service.
options.explanation: Layanan kedua tidak lagi mendapat salinan independen.

options.text: Allow anonymous SendMessage from every principal without a source restriction.
options.explanation: Izin lebih luas dari topic yang diperlukan.

options.text: Allow the SNS service to send messages with a condition restricting the source to the intended topic ARN.
options.explanation: Policy membatasi pengirim layanan pada topic yang dipercaya.

question: An approval workflow can pause for two days while a person reviews a request. It must resume from the saved step when approval arrives, without running an idle server or Lambda invocation. Which solution fits?

options.text: Use a Step Functions Express workflow for the two-day callback wait.
options.explanation: Express tidak mendukung pola wait-for-callback yang diminta.

options.text: Use a synchronous ALB request with a two-day idle connection as the workflow state.
options.explanation: Koneksi terbuka bukan penyimpanan progres yang andal.

options.text: Use a Step Functions Standard workflow with a supported callback task-token pattern.
options.explanation: Workflow menyimpan state dan melanjutkan setelah callback, tanpa menahan compute aktif.

options.text: Keep a single Lambda invocation sleeping until the approver responds.
options.explanation: Invocation biasa tidak dapat menunggu dua hari.

question: A Step Functions task calls a service that sometimes returns a transient throttling error. Persistent failures should go to a controlled error branch. Which configuration is best?

options.text: Delete the state machine whenever one request is throttled.
options.explanation: Menghapus definisi bukan strategi recovery pekerjaan.

options.text: Retry every error forever with no delay.
options.explanation: Error permanen tidak selesai dan retry agresif memperberat layanan.

options.text: Use bounded retries with backoff for retryable errors and a Catch transition for remaining failures.
options.explanation: Jeda dan batas retry mengurangi tekanan; Catch memberi jalur kegagalan yang eksplisit.

options.text: Ignore every failure and mark the task successful.
options.explanation: Workflow dapat mengklaim hasil yang belum terjadi.

question: A workflow reserves inventory and then requests payment from an external provider. Payment may fail permanently after the reservation succeeds. Which design choices improve recovery? Select TWO.

options.text: Use idempotent operation identifiers for retried external steps.
options.explanation: Retry tidak seharusnya menggandakan efek bisnis yang sama.

options.text: Define an explicit compensation step that releases inventory when payment cannot complete.
options.explanation: Compensation mengembalikan hasil bisnis sesuai jalur kegagalan.

options.text: Record the order as paid before sending the payment request.
options.explanation: State sukses mendahului bukti pembayaran dan dapat salah.

options.text: Retry all declined payments indefinitely without checking the failure type.
options.explanation: Kegagalan permanen tidak selesai hanya dengan retry.

options.text: Assume Step Functions automatically rolls back every external service side effect.
options.explanation: Orkestrasi tidak memberi transaksi database lintas seluruh layanan.

question: A web application stores login sessions only in EC2 memory. Users lose their sessions when Auto Scaling replaces an instance. Which change best removes this dependency?

options.text: Increase the Auto Scaling maximum without changing session storage.
options.explanation: Lebih banyak instance tidak membagi state secara otomatis.

options.text: Enable sticky sessions and continue storing the only copy of session data locally.
options.explanation: Affinity tidak memulihkan data setelah instance hilang.

options.text: Use one very large instance and disable replacements permanently.
options.explanation: Ini mengurangi ketahanan dan tidak menyelesaikan ketergantungan state.

options.text: Store session state in an appropriate shared service and let any application instance retrieve it.
options.explanation: Session tidak lagi melekat pada memori instance yang dapat diganti.

question: A stateless web tier runs on replaceable EC2 instances in multiple AZs. Uploaded documents are accessed through an object-storage API, not a shared POSIX file system. The application must keep those documents when an instance is replaced. Which design is most appropriate?

options.text: Enable load-balancer stickiness while keeping the only document copy on local scratch storage.
options.explanation: Stickiness mengarahkan request, bukan melindungi file ketika instance atau storage ephemeral hilang.

options.text: Store uploaded documents in S3 and persist their object references in the application data model.
options.explanation: S3 memisahkan dokumen dari lifecycle instance dan cocok dengan antarmuka object API yang diminta.

options.text: Keep documents only in each server's memory and rebuild instances more frequently.
options.explanation: Memori instance bersifat ephemeral; replace instance tidak boleh menghilangkan satu-satunya salinan dokumen.

options.text: Store each document only on the local instance that first receives its upload.
options.explanation: Data lokal saja tidak mempertahankan akses saat instance diganti dan tidak dibagikan secara durable antar-instance.

question: Workers process queued jobs on replaceable EC2 instances. A worker may terminate at any point. Which actions best preserve work and allow safe recovery? Select TWO.

options.text: Assume all instance shutdowns will run the application's cleanup script successfully.
options.explanation: Gangguan dapat terjadi tanpa cleanup yang selesai.

options.text: Keep the only completion record in the worker's memory.
options.explanation: Record hilang saat instance diganti.

options.text: Make retried processing idempotent using a stable job identifier.
options.explanation: Redelivery setelah kegagalan tidak menggandakan efek bisnis.

options.text: Persist the completed business result before acknowledging or deleting the corresponding message.
options.explanation: Hasil durable harus ada sebelum pekerjaan dianggap selesai.

options.text: Delete messages immediately on receipt to prevent all retries.
options.explanation: Kegagalan setelah delete kehilangan pekerjaan.

question: A team has a containerized HTTP service and wants automatic replacement of failed tasks across Availability Zones without managing an EC2 worker fleet. Which architecture best matches?

options.text: Deploy an EKS cluster with self-managed nodes solely to avoid managing compute hosts.
options.explanation: Self-managed nodes tetap memerlukan pengelolaan host dan menambah komponen.

options.text: Use an SQS queue as the HTTP server without any compute consumers.
options.explanation: Queue menyimpan pesan, bukan menjalankan container HTTP.

options.text: Run the container manually on one EC2 instance with no service scheduler.
options.explanation: Instance tunggal dan operasi manual tidak memenuhi replacement multi-AZ.

options.text: Run an ECS service on Fargate across multiple subnets behind an ALB.
options.explanation: Fargate menghilangkan manajemen host; ECS service menjaga task yang diperlukan.

question: An SQS-triggered Lambda worker overwhelms a small database during bursts. The database has a known safe concurrency level, and jobs may wait in the queue. Which design improvement is most appropriate?

options.text: Remove all concurrency controls so Lambda consumes the backlog as fast as possible.
options.explanation: Ini memperbesar beban yang sudah melampaui database.

options.text: Limit consumer concurrency to the tested downstream capacity and retain queued work for later processing.
options.explanation: Backpressure membatasi tekanan; queue menyerap backlog yang dapat ditunda.

options.text: Reduce queue retention below the expected backlog processing time.
options.explanation: Pekerjaan dapat kedaluwarsa sebelum diproses.

options.text: Delete excess messages whenever the database refuses a connection.
options.explanation: Menghapus pekerjaan bukan pemulihan yang andal.

question: A company is moving an application that uses an ActiveMQ-compatible broker and JMS. It wants a managed broker with minimal changes to the existing messaging protocol and client code. Which service should it evaluate first?

options.text: Amazon SQS as a drop-in JMS broker replacement without reviewing client compatibility.
options.explanation: SQS memiliki API dan semantik berbeda; bukan pengganti transparan semua fitur broker.

options.text: Amazon MQ with a compatible ActiveMQ engine and deployment mode.
options.explanation: Amazon MQ mempertahankan ekosistem broker dan protokol yang sudah digunakan.

options.text: Amazon EventBridge while retaining every broker-specific operation unchanged.
options.explanation: Event bus bukan implementasi transparan seluruh API broker lama.

options.text: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams as a protocol-identical ActiveMQ broker.
options.explanation: Streaming Kinesis bukan broker ActiveMQ/JMS yang sama.

question: A stateless website must continue serving requests after one Availability Zone fails. Its data tier is already resilient. Which application-tier design best addresses this requirement?

options.text: Use an Auto Scaling group restricted to one AZ and increase its maximum size.
options.explanation: Group tetap tidak dapat melayani dari AZ lain.

options.text: Use an ALB and an Auto Scaling group spanning multiple AZs, with capacity planning for the surviving AZs.
options.explanation: Distribusi dan headroom memungkinkan layanan bertahan saat kapasitas satu AZ hilang.

options.text: Use two EC2 instances in different subnets within the same AZ.
options.explanation: Subnet berbeda tidak menghilangkan kegagalan bersama satu AZ.

options.text: Use one large instance with an Elastic IP and a daily snapshot.
options.explanation: Snapshot membantu recovery, bukan kontinuitas request saat AZ gagal.

question: An EC2 instance passes host status checks but its application repeatedly fails the ALB health check. Auto Scaling currently uses only EC2 health checks. What should be changed to replace failed application instances?

options.text: Increase the instance's DNS TTL so health status changes less often.
options.explanation: TTL tidak membuat Auto Scaling memakai health check ALB.

options.text: Increase maximum group size but keep the unhealthy instance permanently in service.
options.explanation: Kapasitas maksimum bukan sinyal replacement.

options.text: Disable ALB health checks so the application always appears healthy.
options.explanation: Ini menyembunyikan kegagalan alih-alih memulihkan layanan.

options.text: Enable load balancer health checks for the Auto Scaling group and configure suitable health-check grace behavior.
options.explanation: Auto Scaling harus menggunakan sinyal kesehatan aplikasi yang relevan.

question: A VPC uses zonal public NAT gateways. Private subnets in AZ A and AZ B currently route through the NAT gateway in AZ A. The team must retain the zonal NAT design but remove AZ A as the shared egress dependency. What should it do?

options.text: Deploy a zonal NAT gateway in AZ B and route each AZ's private subnets through its local NAT gateway.
options.explanation: Kegagalan AZ A tidak lagi memutus jalur egress subnet AZ B.

options.text: Replace the private route with an internet gateway route while leaving instances without public IPv4 addresses.
options.explanation: Ini bukan pengganti NAT untuk akses internet IPv4 dari instance tersebut.

options.text: Attach a second Elastic IP to the existing NAT gateway and treat it as cross-AZ failover.
options.explanation: Alamat tambahan tidak memindahkan resource zonal ke AZ lain.

options.text: Add a second zonal NAT gateway in AZ A and keep all routes pointing into AZ A.
options.explanation: AZ A tetap menjadi dependency bersama.

question: An RDS PostgreSQL workload requires automatic AZ failover. Long reporting queries must also run away from the primary, and reports can tolerate replication lag. Which design meets both needs?

options.text: Use a larger Single-AZ primary for both transactions and reports.
options.explanation: Kapasitas lebih besar tidak menambah failover AZ atau memisahkan reporting.

options.text: Use a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment with one standby and add a separate read replica for reporting.
options.explanation: Standby menangani failover; read replica menangani query reporting.

options.text: Use a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment with one standby and send reports to that standby.
options.explanation: Standby jenis deployment ini tidak melayani query baca.

options.text: Keep a Single-AZ primary and rely only on manual promotion of its read replica.
options.explanation: Manual promotion tidak memenuhi automatic failover yang diminta.

source.title: RDS Multi-AZ DB instance with one standby

question: A buggy deployment deletes important rows from an RDS database. The same changes reach the standby. Automated backups and point-in-time recovery were enabled before the incident. Which response addresses this logical data loss?

options.text: Increase database storage capacity to reconstruct deleted rows automatically.
options.explanation: Kapasitas storage tidak menjadi rollback data.

options.text: Add another read replica after the deletion and expect it to recover the lost rows.
options.explanation: Replica baru berasal dari state saat ini, bukan otomatis sebelum incident.

options.text: Restore to a new DB instance at a valid time before the deletion, validate it, and plan the application cutover.
options.explanation: PITR mengembalikan state historis; failover saja tidak membatalkan delete yang sudah direplikasi.

options.text: Fail over to the standby and assume it contains the pre-deletion data.
options.explanation: Standby sudah menerima perubahan yang salah.

question: An Aurora cluster has one writer and no Aurora Replicas. The company wants a ready compute instance that can be promoted if the writer's AZ fails. Which change is most appropriate?

options.text: Keep the only compute instance in the writer AZ and shorten the backup interval instead of adding a replica.
options.explanation: Backup lebih sering dapat memperbaiki recovery point, tetapi bukan compute standby yang sudah berjalan untuk dipromosikan.

options.text: Add a reader in the same AZ only and declare the design AZ-independent.
options.explanation: Reader masih memiliki dependency AZ yang sama.

options.text: Rely only on the replicated cluster storage and assume a second running compute instance already exists.
options.explanation: Durability storage tidak berarti ada reader compute siap pakai.

options.text: Add an appropriately sized Aurora Replica in another AZ and configure promotion priorities as needed.
options.explanation: Replica compute di AZ lain menyediakan kandidat failover yang siap.

question: A noncritical application can lose up to 24 hours of data and remain unavailable for up to eight hours after a regional disaster. Tested restoration from cross-Region backups meets both objectives. Which strategy minimizes continuously running standby infrastructure?

options.text: Run a full-capacity active-active deployment in two Regions.
options.explanation: Bisa resilient, tetapi lebih banyak infrastruktur berjalan daripada yang diperlukan.

options.text: Use backup and restore with tested infrastructure automation and cross-Region backups.
options.explanation: Hasil uji memenuhi tujuan tanpa menjalankan aplikasi standby sepanjang waktu.

options.text: Keep backups only in the primary Region and plan to use them when that entire Region is unavailable.
options.explanation: Recovery regional memerlukan salinan/dependensi yang tersedia di luar failure scope tersebut.

options.text: Run a full-capacity warm standby permanently even though restore already meets the targets.
options.explanation: Kapasitas standby tidak diperlukan oleh batasan yang diberikan.

question: A company maintains a functional copy of its application in a second Region at reduced capacity. Data is replicated continuously. During disaster recovery, the team scales up the secondary environment and switches traffic. Which strategy is described?

options.text: Warm standby.
options.explanation: Sistem sekunder sudah fungsional tetapi kapasitasnya lebih kecil.

options.text: Full-capacity active-active with both Regions continuously serving production traffic.
options.explanation: Sekunder belum aktif melayani trafik produksi dan belum full capacity.

options.text: Pilot light with only core data services running and no functional application tier.
options.explanation: Soal menyatakan aplikasi sekunder sudah fungsional, bukan hanya komponen inti.

options.text: Backup and restore only.
options.explanation: Pola itu membangun kembali lingkungan dari backup, bukan menjalankan salinan fungsional.

question: A key-value application needs local reads and writes in two AWS Regions. The team accepts the documented eventual-consistency and conflict behavior for its data model and does not want to implement replication itself. Which design fits?

options.text: Create independent DynamoDB tables in each Region and configure only cross-Region backup copies.
options.explanation: Backup copies bukan active read/write replication antara kedua tabel untuk operasi aplikasi sehari-hari.

options.text: Use latency-based DNS to send requests to independent tables without any data replication.
options.explanation: Routing memilih endpoint tetapi tidak menyinkronkan data yang ditulis pada tabel terpisah.

options.text: Use a single-Region DynamoDB table with a GSI and treat the index as a writable cross-Region replica.
options.explanation: GSI bukan independently writable cross-Region table replica.

options.text: Use DynamoDB global tables configured for multi-Region eventual consistency and design application conflict handling appropriately.
options.explanation: Global tables menyediakan replica multi-active; model data harus menerima semantik MREC.

source.title: DynamoDB global tables and consistency modes

question: A company wants recoverable copies of supported AWS resources outside the production account. Production operators must not have deletion rights over those copies. Which design best provides this isolation?

options.text: Copy backups to another vault in the same production account while keeping unrestricted production deletion permissions.
options.explanation: Menambah vault tanpa pemisahan ownership/permission tidak membentuk perlindungan dari operator production yang diminta.

options.text: Store every backup in the production account under the same unrestricted operator role.
options.explanation: Kompromi atau kesalahan role yang sama tetap memengaruhi backup.

options.text: Copy backups into a dedicated backup account and restrict destination vault and key permissions separately.
options.explanation: Salinan dan kontrol akses tidak lagi seluruhnya berada di akun produksi.

options.text: Create read replicas only and treat them as immutable historical backups.
options.explanation: Replica dapat menerima perubahan salah dan bukan histori immutable.

question: A DynamoDB table had point-in-time recovery enabled before an accidental deletion. The team needs data from shortly before the incident. Which recovery plan is correct?

options.text: Restore to a new table at the selected available recovery time, validate settings and data, and update application references.
options.explanation: PITR menghasilkan tabel baru; aplikasi dan konfigurasi pendukung perlu disesuaikan.

options.text: Restore the latest table schema only and expect indexes to reconstruct deleted item values.
options.explanation: Schema/index definition bukan salinan historis data item yang telah dihapus.

options.text: Enable PITR only after the deletion and recover any historical time from before it was enabled.
options.explanation: Fitur tidak menciptakan histori yang sebelumnya tidak dicadangkan.

options.text: Expect PITR to rewind the existing table in place without a new table.
options.explanation: Restore yang didokumentasikan membuat tabel baru.

question: A company enables S3 cross-Region live replication on a bucket that already contains years of data. It needs new writes and the existing objects copied to the destination. Which actions meet this requirement? Select TWO.

options.text: Disable source versioning after configuring replication to improve correctness.
options.explanation: Ini bertentangan dengan prasyarat replication versioning.

options.text: Replace replication with an HTTP redirect to the source bucket.
options.explanation: Redirect tidak menyimpan salinan data di destination.

options.text: Assume enabling live replication automatically copies every pre-existing object.
options.explanation: Live replication bukan backfill seluruh objek historis.

options.text: Use S3 Batch Replication for eligible objects that existed before live replication was enabled.
options.explanation: Batch Replication menangani objek lama yang tidak dicakup live replication retroaktif.

options.text: Configure the required versioning, replication permissions, and live replication rules for eligible new writes.
options.explanation: Live replication menangani objek baru sesuai rule dan prasyarat.

question: A website has a primary deployment and a ready standby deployment in another Region. Its data recovery process is already handled. The company wants DNS to prefer the primary and return the standby when the primary is unhealthy. Which configuration fits?

options.text: Use equal weighted records for both deployments even while the primary remains healthy.
options.explanation: Equal weighting menjalankan pembagian traffic, bukan prefer-primary/failover-only behavior yang diminta.

options.text: Route 53 failover records with suitable health evaluation for the endpoints.
options.explanation: Failover policy sesuai pola primary-secondary.

options.text: Route 53 simple routing to the primary only, with no standby record or health evaluation.
options.explanation: DNS tidak memiliki jalur secondary untuk dipilih.

options.text: Keep the standby DNS record but omit health evaluation and always return the primary answer.
options.explanation: Record standby saja tidak membuat health-based failover bekerja.

question: An ALB target group contains only unhealthy registered targets in all enabled Availability Zones. An engineer assumes the ALB must stop forwarding all traffic. Which behavior should the design account for?

options.text: The ALB can fail open and route requests to the unhealthy registered targets.
options.explanation: Dokumentasi menyebut fail-open pada kondisi semua target unhealthy.

options.text: The ALB automatically launches healthy replacements even without a scaling service integration.
options.explanation: Load balancer tidak otomatis menjadi compute fleet manager; provisioning replacement membutuhkan mekanisme lain seperti Auto Scaling.

options.text: The ALB guarantees that no request can reach any unhealthy target under any circumstance.
options.explanation: Klaim absolut ini bertentangan dengan perilaku fail-open.

options.text: The ALB always returns HTTP 503 whenever any unhealthy target remains registered.
options.explanation: Kondisi no registered targets berbeda dari all unhealthy; asumsi selalu 503 tidak menggambarkan fail-open yang didokumentasikan.

source.title: ALB target health and fail-open behavior

question: A CloudFront distribution serves downloadable static files using GET requests. A synchronized secondary origin is ready. The team wants CloudFront to use it when the primary returns selected server error codes. Which configuration fits?

options.text: Create an origin group with primary and secondary origins and configure the applicable failover status codes.
options.explanation: Origin group memberi jalur failover untuk request yang memenuhi kriteria.

options.text: Increase cache TTLs and assume uncached files can always be retrieved when the primary origin fails.
options.explanation: Cache tidak menjamin setiap objek ada di edge; uncached requests tetap membutuhkan origin yang tersedia.

options.text: Use a custom error page from the primary origin as the only recovery mechanism.
options.explanation: Custom error response bukan konfigurasi secondary origin failover yang melayani file yang diminta.

options.text: Add a second origin but never reference an origin group in cache behaviors.
options.explanation: Origin kedua saja tidak mengaktifkan mekanisme failover.

question: An NFS-based application runs across two AZs. Its shared file storage must remain available if one AZ fails. Which storage deployment best meets the requirement?

options.text: EFS Regional with mount targets in the application AZs.
options.explanation: Regional EFS menyimpan data lintas AZ dan mount targets menyediakan akses klien.

options.text: EFS One Zone located only in the first application AZ.
options.explanation: One Zone tidak memberi ketahanan data lintas AZ yang diminta.

options.text: One EBS volume in the first AZ attached as a cross-AZ NFS filesystem automatically.
options.explanation: EBS tidak otomatis menjadi layanan NFS lintas AZ.

options.text: A single NFS server on EC2 with all data on local instance store.
options.explanation: Server dan media lokal menjadi dependency tunggal.

question: A Windows application needs a managed SMB file share integrated with Active Directory and automatic failover across AZs. Which option best matches these requirements?

options.text: An EFS mount exposed directly as native SMB without an SMB server.
options.explanation: EFS menyediakan NFS, bukan native SMB endpoint seperti yang diminta.

options.text: A Single-AZ FSx for Windows file system and a promise that snapshots provide uninterrupted failover.
options.explanation: Snapshot bukan standby lintas AZ yang melayani failover otomatis.

options.text: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server with a Multi-AZ deployment.
options.explanation: Layanan dan deployment sesuai SMB, integrasi Windows, dan failover AZ.

options.text: An S3 bucket mounted through custom software while assuming all SMB locking semantics are identical.
options.explanation: Gateway custom bukan pengganti teruji untuk kebutuhan SMB yang disebut.

question: A fault-tolerant batch job uses fast local scratch storage on replaceable instances. It can resume from a checkpoint. Which design preserves recoverability if an instance disappears?

options.text: Periodically write checkpoints to durable storage and recreate local scratch data when resuming.
options.explanation: Checkpoint durable memungkinkan melanjutkan tanpa mengandalkan disk instance lama.

options.text: Keep the only checkpoint on the same local scratch volume.
options.explanation: Kehilangan instance dapat menghilangkan scratch dan checkpoint sekaligus.

options.text: Create a checkpoint only after the entire job finishes, leaving no progress recoverable during execution.
options.explanation: Checkpoint akhir tidak memberi resume point untuk kegagalan di tengah job.

options.text: Copy the checkpoint to another directory on the same instance store device.
options.explanation: Direktori berbeda pada perangkat ephemeral yang sama tidak mengubah failure domain.

question: A company must preserve hybrid connectivity if one Direct Connect location becomes unavailable. Which improvement most directly reduces that shared-failure risk?

options.text: Provision redundant connectivity through separate Direct Connect locations with independent on-premises paths.
options.explanation: Lokasi dan path berbeda mengurangi dependency fasilitas yang sama.

options.text: Increase bandwidth on the existing connection without adding an alternate path.
options.explanation: Kapasitas lebih besar tidak menambah redundansi lokasi.

options.text: Add another connection to the same device at the same Direct Connect location only.
options.explanation: Kegagalan lokasi masih dapat memutus kedua connection.

options.text: Add a second VLAN over the existing single physical connection.
options.explanation: VLAN tambahan berbagi link fisik yang sama.

question: An on-premises team configured only one of the two tunnels in a Site-to-Site VPN connection. Maintenance of that tunnel interrupts connectivity. What should it do?

options.text: Configure both tunnels and verify routing and failover behavior on the customer gateway.
options.explanation: Dua tunnel baru berguna jika konfigurasi dan routing benar-benar dapat memakai keduanya.

options.text: Create an additional VPC route to the same tunnel but leave the second tunnel unconfigured.
options.explanation: Rute tambahan ke tunnel yang sama tidak menyediakan jalur tunnel kedua ketika maintenance terjadi.

options.text: Use only DNS failover between two names that both resolve to the same configured tunnel.
options.explanation: Nama berbeda tidak menyediakan tunnel independen yang sudah dikonfigurasi dan siap dirutekan.

options.text: Keep one tunnel and only increase its idle timeout.
options.explanation: Timeout tidak memberi jalur saat endpoint tunnel tidak tersedia.

question: A critical application has redundant network connections and a documented disaster recovery runbook. Which actions provide evidence that recovery objectives can actually be met? Select TWO.

options.text: Treat the number of connections as proof of zero downtime without testing.
options.explanation: Jumlah link tidak menjamin semua konfigurasi dan dependency benar.

options.text: Test only a DNS change without checking application dependencies or the backup path.
options.explanation: DNS switch saja tidak membuktikan aplikasi, data, dan dependency dapat pulih sesuai RTO/RPO.

options.text: Assume replication makes any future recovery point objective automatically zero.
options.explanation: RPO bergantung pada teknologi dan keadaan, bukan sekadar kata replication.

options.text: Run controlled failover exercises and measure application recovery and data loss against the stated objectives.
options.explanation: Pengukuran menguji hasil end-to-end, bukan hanya keberadaan resource.

options.text: Verify backup-path capacity, routing, credentials, and dependencies during the exercises.
options.explanation: Jalur hidup tetapi terlalu kecil atau kehilangan dependency belum memenuhi tujuan aplikasi.

question: A company already uses Kubernetes manifests, operators, and Kubernetes-native deployment tools. It wants AWS to operate the Kubernetes control plane while preserving those interfaces. Which platform fits?

options.text: AWS Batch as a replacement for all Kubernetes operators.
options.explanation: Scheduler batch bukan pengganti control plane Kubernetes untuk aplikasi umum.

options.text: Amazon EKS with a suitable worker-compute model.
options.explanation: EKS mempertahankan Kubernetes API; pilihan node tetap disesuaikan kebutuhan aplikasi.

options.text: Amazon ECS after importing the Kubernetes manifests without conversion.
options.explanation: ECS memakai model task dan service sendiri, bukan API Kubernetes yang sama.

options.text: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling alone as the Kubernetes control plane.
options.explanation: Auto Scaling hanya mengelola kapasitas instance, bukan control plane Kubernetes.

question: An ECS service uses rolling deployments and has a previous completed deployment. New task revisions sometimes fail to start or fail health checks. The team wants failed releases stopped and automatically rolled back. What should it configure?

options.text: The ECS deployment circuit breaker with rollback enabled.
options.explanation: Mekanisme ini menilai steady state dan dapat kembali ke deployment completed sebelumnya.

options.text: A higher desired task count while ignoring target health.
options.explanation: Menambah task gagal tidak menjamin pemulihan versi yang sehat.

options.text: Longer DNS TTL values for the service endpoint.
options.explanation: Cache DNS tidak mengatasi kegagalan startup task baru.

options.text: An SQS dead-letter queue as the ECS deployment controller.
options.explanation: DLQ menyimpan pesan gagal, bukan mengembalikan revision service.

question: Fargate tasks cannot pull a private ECR image. Network access is working, and the application task role already allows access to its DynamoDB table. Which permission location should the architect inspect for the image-pull failure?

options.text: The DynamoDB table resource policy exclusively.
options.explanation: Policy tabel tidak memberikan izin menarik image ECR.

options.text: The task execution role used by the ECS/Fargate agent.
options.explanation: Agent memakai execution role untuk pull image; role aplikasi bukan jalur izin tersebut.

options.text: The application task role only, because no separate agent role exists.
options.explanation: ECS membedakan task role dari task execution role.

options.text: The ALB listener certificate policy.
options.explanation: Sertifikat frontend tidak memberi izin ECR pada agent.

question: A Lambda function processes batches from an SQS standard queue. One invalid record causes every successful record in the batch to be retried. Which change reduces unnecessary retries?

options.text: Disable all retries and rely on the visibility timeout to store permanent results.
options.explanation: Visibility timeout bukan penyimpanan hasil atau pengganti penanganan gagal.

options.text: Return success for the whole batch even when one record failed.
options.explanation: Pesan gagal dapat dianggap selesai dan hilang dari pemrosesan.

options.text: Enable partial batch responses and return identifiers of failed records while keeping processing idempotent.
options.explanation: Lambda dapat mengulang item gagal saja; duplicate delivery tetap mungkin sehingga idempotensi tetap perlu.

options.text: Increase the batch size so more successful records share each failure.
options.explanation: Batch lebih besar dapat menambah pekerjaan yang terulang.

question: A worker bug moved valid SQS messages into a dead-letter queue. The bug is fixed, but downstream capacity is limited. What is the safest recovery plan?

options.text: Validate representative messages, redrive at a controlled rate, and monitor the downstream service and duplicate effects.
options.explanation: Redrive terkendali memulihkan pekerjaan tanpa langsung membanjiri dependency; idempotensi tetap dibutuhkan.

options.text: Move all messages back immediately and remove downstream concurrency limits.
options.explanation: Lonjakan ulang dapat membuat dependency gagal lagi.

options.text: Increase the maximum receive count without inspecting or replaying stored messages.
options.explanation: Perubahan policy tidak otomatis menyelesaikan backlog yang sudah di DLQ.

options.text: Delete the dead-letter queue because the worker code is now fixed.
options.explanation: Perbaikan kode tidak memproses kembali pesan yang masih tersimpan.

question: EC2 queue workers average two seconds per job. The target is about 60 seconds of queued work per active worker. Which target backlog per worker is a reasonable initial value for a target-tracking policy, before load testing?

options.text: 2 messages per worker.
options.explanation: Waktu proses per pesan bukan langsung jumlah backlog yang memenuhi 60 detik.

options.text: 60 messages per worker regardless of processing time.
options.explanation: Mengabaikan durasi pekerjaan membuat perkiraan waktu tunggu keliru.

options.text: 30 messages per worker.
options.explanation: 60 detik dibagi 2 detik per pesan menghasilkan 30 pesan; startup dan variasi waktu tetap perlu diuji.

options.text: 120 messages per worker.
options.explanation: Mengalikan waktu menghasilkan satuan yang salah untuk panjang antrean target.

question: An EventBridge bus feeds several services. A new consumer bug is discovered after events were delivered successfully. The team wants to reprocess a selected historical time range without asking producers to recreate events. What should have been configured?

options.text: An EventBridge archive with suitable retention, followed by a controlled replay to the source bus.
options.explanation: Archive menyimpan event untuk replay setelah pengiriman awal; efek samping replay harus dikendalikan.

options.text: Only a target dead-letter queue for events that failed delivery.
options.explanation: Event yang berhasil dikirim tetapi salah diproses tidak otomatis ada di delivery DLQ.

options.text: Only a longer API timeout on producers.
options.explanation: Timeout tidak menyediakan arsip event historis.

options.text: Only CloudWatch metrics for the count of events.
options.explanation: Jumlah event tidak menyimpan payload bisnis yang diperlukan.

question: A company needs a scheduled flow of Salesforce records into S3 for analytics. The supported connector meets its field-mapping and volume requirements. It wants minimal custom API polling and credential-handling code. Which service fits?

options.text: AWS DataSync pointed at a Salesforce HTTPS API as an NFS source.
options.explanation: DataSync bukan konektor API Salesforce dengan model sumber NFS tersebut.

options.text: Amazon AppFlow.
options.explanation: AppFlow menyediakan konektor SaaS dan flow terjadwal tanpa membangun seluruh integrasi sendiri.

options.text: AWS Application Migration Service to replicate Salesforce-managed servers.
options.explanation: Rehosting server tidak berlaku pada layanan SaaS yang tidak dikelola pelanggan.

options.text: Amazon SQS alone polling Salesforce automatically.
options.explanation: Queue tidak otomatis menjadi konektor SaaS.

question: External partners must continue uploading files with existing SFTP clients. Files should arrive in S3, and the company does not want to patch or scale SFTP servers. Which design fits?

options.text: A DataSync task that accepts inbound SFTP user sessions directly.
options.explanation: Task transfer bukan endpoint SFTP untuk sesi partner.

options.text: An S3 static website endpoint with SFTP enabled on port 22.
options.explanation: Website endpoint S3 bukan server SFTP.

options.text: An AWS Transfer Family SFTP endpoint backed by S3 with appropriate user access mappings.
options.explanation: Transfer Family mempertahankan protokol partner dan mengelola endpoint transfer.

options.text: An S3 File Gateway SMB share without changing partner clients.
options.explanation: SMB bukan protokol SFTP yang diwajibkan.

question: A document-processing application receives scanned invoices. It needs extracted text plus table cells and form key-value pairs without training an OCR model. Which managed capability should the architecture use?

options.text: Amazon Transcribe batch jobs on the image files.
options.explanation: Transcribe berfokus pada audio ucapan.

options.text: Amazon Comprehend sentiment analysis on the raw image bytes.
options.explanation: Analisis sentimen bukan ekstraksi struktur invoice dari citra.

options.text: Amazon Polly text-to-speech on the scanned invoice.
options.explanation: Polly menghasilkan audio dari teks, bukan membaca tabel hasil scan.

options.text: Amazon Textract document analysis.
options.explanation: Textract mengekstrak struktur dokumen seperti form dan tabel, bukan hanya menyimpan gambar.

question: A support platform already stores UTF-8 customer comments. It needs sentiment scores and named entities in supported languages with minimal model operations. Which service fits this processing stage?

options.text: Amazon Comprehend.
options.explanation: Comprehend menyediakan analisis bahasa alami pada teks yang sudah tersedia.

options.text: Amazon Transcribe speech recognition.
options.explanation: Input bukan audio yang perlu ditranskripsi.

options.text: Amazon Polly speech synthesis.
options.explanation: Sintesis ucapan tidak menghasilkan sentimen dan entitas.

options.text: Amazon Textract table extraction.
options.explanation: Tidak perlu OCR atau deteksi tabel untuk komentar yang sudah berupa teks.

question: A company must quickly move supported virtual machines to EC2 with minimal application changes. It needs continuous block-level replication, test launches, and a controlled cutover. Which service should it evaluate?

options.text: AWS Transfer Family as an automated operating-system converter.
options.explanation: Endpoint transfer file tidak menyediakan rehosting server.

options.text: Amazon AppFlow as a hypervisor replication service.
options.explanation: AppFlow memindahkan data SaaS, bukan disk VM.

options.text: AWS Application Migration Service (MGN, now documented as AWS Transform MGN).
options.explanation: MGN mereplikasi server untuk rehost; aplikasi tetap perlu pengujian saat cutover.

options.text: AWS DMS Schema Conversion alone.
options.explanation: Konversi skema tidak mereplikasi OS dan aplikasi seluruh server.

question: A recovery exercise found that manually rebuilding security groups, subnets, and application resources took hours and introduced configuration differences. Backups of application data already exist. Which change most directly improves repeatability?

options.text: Increase backup frequency but continue rebuilding all infrastructure from memory.
options.explanation: Backup data tidak menghilangkan variasi konfigurasi manual.

options.text: Use a larger instance in the recovery Region without testing permissions.
options.explanation: Ukuran instance tidak memperbaiki reproduksibilitas jaringan dan IAM.

options.text: Maintain tested infrastructure-as-code templates and combine deployment with a documented data-restore procedure.
options.explanation: Template memulihkan konfigurasi; backup memulihkan state. Keduanya memiliki peran berbeda.

options.text: Copy production instance names into a spreadsheet as the full recovery mechanism.
options.explanation: Nama tidak mendeskripsikan dependency dan konfigurasi resource.

question: A Lambda function processes every ObjectCreated event in an S3 bucket and writes its output back to that bucket. It repeatedly invokes itself. Which redesign prevents this loop while keeping new source files processed?

options.text: Increase the function timeout so recursion finishes in one invocation.
options.explanation: Setiap penulisan tetap dapat menghasilkan event baru.

options.text: Trigger only on an input prefix and write to a different output prefix, or use separate buckets.
options.explanation: Output tidak lagi memenuhi filter event input sehingga rantai pemanggilan berhenti.

options.text: Disable all S3 event notifications and manually invoke every future job.
options.explanation: Menghentikan otomatisasi seluruh input tidak diperlukan untuk memisahkan sumber dan hasil.

options.text: Increase Lambda concurrency to process the recursive backlog faster.
options.explanation: Memperbesar kapasitas tidak menghilangkan penyebab recursion.

question: An SNS topic carries order events with a region message attribute. Separate SQS queues should receive only events for their assigned region. Producers should publish once without knowing queue names. Which design fits?

options.text: Change the SQS visibility timeout based on the region attribute.
options.explanation: Visibility timeout tidak memilih subscription penerima.

options.text: Apply subscription filter policies for the region attribute to each SNS subscription.
options.explanation: Filter subscription memisahkan distribusi tanpa membuat routing khusus pada producer.

options.text: Use one shared SQS queue and let consumers delete messages for other regions.
options.explanation: Consumer dapat menghapus pesan yang dibutuhkan consumer lain.

options.text: Create a producer IAM user for every message and use the username as routing.
options.explanation: Identitas IAM bukan mekanisme filter subscription dan menambah administrasi.

question: Workers process 500 MB source documents, far larger than a normal SQS message. The system needs durable queuing and retries without splitting each document into queue fragments. Which design is appropriate?

options.text: Increase the SQS visibility timeout until a 500 MB message is accepted.
options.explanation: Timeout tidak mengubah batas ukuran payload.

options.text: Store each document in S3 and queue a reference with controlled access and coordinated retention.
options.explanation: Queue memuat pointer kecil; payload tetap tahan lama dan dapat diambil ulang oleh worker.

options.text: Base64-encode the document and send it as one ordinary SQS message.
options.explanation: Encoding biasanya menambah ukuran dan tidak menghilangkan batas.

options.text: Store the only copy in producer memory and queue its process ID.
options.explanation: Memory dan process ID tidak memberi payload durable bagi worker lain.

question: A scheduler invokes a billing task at a specified time. Delivery can be retried after transient failures, and a timeout may occur after the task commits its result. Which design protects the business operation?

options.text: Use a stable operation ID with idempotent processing and configure bounded retries plus a failure destination.
options.explanation: Retry dapat terjadi setelah commit; ID operasi membantu mendeteksi hasil yang sudah tercatat.

options.text: Use a new random operation ID on every retry to avoid conflicts.
options.explanation: ID baru membuat satu operasi terlihat seperti operasi bisnis baru.

options.text: Assume scheduled invocations can never be duplicated.
options.explanation: Asumsi exactly-once end-to-end tidak aman untuk pengiriman dengan retry.

options.text: Disable persistence until the scheduler confirms delivery.
options.explanation: Konfirmasi jaringan tidak menjamin efek bisnis selesai tepat sekali.

question: A tested recovery takes 40 minutes. Backups occur every four hours, and a failure can happen just before the next backup. The business requires an RTO of one hour and an RPO of 30 minutes. What must change?

options.text: Reduce potential data loss with more frequent protection or replication; the measured recovery time already meets the RTO.
options.explanation: 40 menit memenuhi RTO 60 menit, tetapi kehilangan hampir 4 jam melampaui RPO 30 menit.

options.text: Increase the backup interval to reduce backup overhead.
options.explanation: Interval lebih panjang memperbesar potensi kehilangan data.

options.text: Nothing, because RTO and RPO are interchangeable measurements.
options.explanation: Kedua target mengukur hal berbeda dan harus dipenuhi terpisah.

options.text: Only shorten recovery time to 20 minutes; the backup interval already meets the RPO.
options.explanation: RPO berkaitan dengan data yang hilang, bukan durasi restore.

question: A secondary Region continuously maintains the critical database state. Application servers are not running there, but tested automation can provision them and switch traffic during recovery. Which DR strategy is this?

options.text: Warm standby with a fully functional reduced-capacity application.
options.explanation: Warm standby biasanya sudah memiliki aplikasi fungsional dalam skala kecil.

options.text: Backup and restore with no continuously maintained core components.
options.explanation: Deskripsi menyebut komponen data inti terus dipelihara, bukan hanya arsip backup.

options.text: Active-active because the database exists in two Regions.
options.explanation: Keberadaan data tidak berarti kedua Region melayani workload aktif.

options.text: Pilot light.
options.explanation: Komponen inti dipertahankan; tier aplikasi dinyalakan ketika pemulihan diperlukan.

question: A warm-standby environment works at small scale. During a DR exercise, scaling it to production capacity fails because account quotas and subnet IP capacity are insufficient. Which preparation is missing?

options.text: Use a shorter DNS TTL while leaving capacity unchanged.
options.explanation: TTL tidak menyediakan kapasitas compute atau IP tambahan.

options.text: Replicate the same data more frequently without testing scale-up.
options.explanation: Replikasi data tidak menyelesaikan batas resource.

options.text: Validate target-Region quotas, network capacity, and scale-up procedures at the required recovery load.
options.explanation: Konfigurasi kecil yang berhasil tidak membuktikan kapasitas saat failover penuh.

options.text: Assume quota increases in the primary Region automatically apply everywhere.
options.explanation: Kuota sering memiliki cakupan akun/Region dan harus diperiksa sesuai layanan.

question: A company uses AWS Backup for supported resources. After a review period, recovery points must not be deleted or have retention shortened by account administrators before policy allows. Which feature should be configured and carefully tested?

options.text: Only a daily email reminder about retention.
options.explanation: Pengingat tidak menegakkan immutability.

options.text: Governance mode while giving every administrator permission to remove the lock.
options.explanation: Mode governance dapat dilepas oleh principal dengan izin yang cukup.

options.text: AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode, allowing its grace period to expire after validation.
options.explanation: Compliance lock menjadi tidak dapat dilepas setelah grace period sesuai ketentuan; salah konfigurasi berdampak panjang.

options.text: An IAM Allow policy granting administrators full backup access.
options.explanation: Allow luas tidak mencegah penghapusan recovery point.

question: S3 replication copies production objects to a second Region. The company also needs recovery from accidental deletions and must preserve earlier versions. Which additional design concern is most important?

options.text: Use a closer Region and omit restore tests.
options.explanation: Jarak tidak membuktikan pemulihan kesalahan logis.

options.text: Configure and test version retention, delete-marker behavior, and protected recovery access rather than treating replication alone as a backup.
options.explanation: Replikasi dan perilaku delete harus dinilai; salinan yang mengikuti kesalahan tidak otomatis menjadi titik pemulihan.

options.text: Assume every replication destination automatically retains all versions forever.
options.explanation: Lifecycle dan penghapusan tetap menentukan retensi.

options.text: Disable versioning at the destination to ensure the newest delete always wins.
options.explanation: Menghilangkan versi justru melemahkan pemulihan.

question: A compatible Aurora application needs low-latency reads in another Region and a regional recovery option. It accepts a measured nonzero replication lag. Which design fits?

options.text: Aurora Global Database with a secondary regional cluster and a tested promotion/failover procedure.
options.explanation: Replica regional mendukung baca lokal dan recovery; lag serta prosedur cutover tetap perlu diuji.

options.text: An Aurora reader endpoint assumed to spread a regional cluster across the world automatically.
options.explanation: Endpoint reader tidak otomatis membuat cluster lintas Region.

options.text: A single-AZ Aurora writer with a DNS alias in another Region.
options.explanation: DNS tidak menciptakan salinan database regional.

options.text: An RDS Proxy in another Region as the only stored copy.
options.explanation: Proxy tidak menyimpan replika data untuk pemulihan.

question: A provisioned ElastiCache Valkey replication group currently has only a primary node. The application can reconstruct cached data, but a primary failure causes an avoidable long outage. Which change improves managed failover?

options.text: Add replicas in other AZs and enable supported Multi-AZ automatic failover; ensure clients reconnect correctly.
options.explanation: Replica siap dapat dipromosikan; aplikasi tetap harus menangani transisi koneksi.

options.text: Increase the cache TTL and assume it prevents node failures.
options.explanation: TTL tidak meningkatkan ketersediaan compute.

options.text: Use a larger single cache node with no replicas.
options.explanation: Kapasitas bertambah tetapi single point of failure tetap ada.

options.text: Only enable an RDS Multi-AZ standby for an unrelated database.
options.explanation: Itu tidak menyediakan pengganti primary cache.

question: An inventory service uses DynamoDB global tables in multi-Region eventual consistency mode. Both Regions may sell the last unit using local conditional writes. Which design issue must be addressed?

options.text: Increasing the TTL makes cross-Region writes strongly consistent.
options.explanation: TTL adalah penghapusan kedaluwarsa, bukan protokol konsistensi.

options.text: A condition evaluated in one Region does not by itself enforce a single global stock decision across concurrent regional writes.
options.explanation: MREC mereplikasi asynchronous; validasi lokal tidak otomatis memberi serialisasi global untuk inventori.

options.text: Storing the item in an S3 cache removes all write conflicts.
options.explanation: Cache tidak mengoordinasikan keputusan transaksi lintas Region.

options.text: Every conditional write automatically locks the item in all Regions before returning.
options.explanation: Itu bukan jaminan mode eventual consistency yang disebutkan.

question: An application uses a Regional EFS file system across two AZs, but all clients mount through a manually pinned endpoint in one AZ. The team wants resilient, local access paths. Which improvement fits?

options.text: Change EFS to One Zone storage while keeping the single pinned endpoint.
options.explanation: Mengurangi redundansi tidak memperbaiki akses lintas AZ.

options.text: Increase file permissions to 777 to bypass an AZ outage.
options.explanation: Izin POSIX tidak memperbaiki kegagalan jaringan atau AZ.

options.text: Copy the mount-target IP into more configuration files.
options.explanation: Menyalin dependency yang sama tidak menciptakan jalur independen.

options.text: Create appropriate mount targets in the application AZs and use supported mount/DNS behavior instead of pinning every client to one target.
options.explanation: Storage regional tetap membutuhkan jalur mount yang benar; endpoint tunggal dapat menjadi dependency akses.

question: EC2 workers are being interrupted by routine Auto Scaling scale-in while uploading results. Which design reduces avoidable interruption yet remains safe for unexpected instance failures?

options.text: Delete each queue message before work begins to prevent redelivery.
options.explanation: Pekerjaan hilang bila instance gagal sebelum selesai.

options.text: Use a termination lifecycle hook to stop taking new jobs and finish or checkpoint work, while retaining retry-safe queue processing.
options.explanation: Hook memberi waktu terbatas untuk shutdown terencana; crash tetap harus ditangani dengan retry dan checkpoint.

options.text: Use a lifecycle hook and remove all job retry logic permanently.
options.explanation: Hook tidak menjamin instance selalu tersedia sampai pekerjaan selesai.

options.text: Raise minimum capacity indefinitely so no instance is ever replaced.
options.explanation: Itu tidak mengatasi failure atau deployment dan dapat memboroskan kapasitas.

question: Route 53 failover changes the healthy answer after an outage, but some clients continue calling the old endpoint. The application uses ordinary DNS records and persistent connections. Which explanation should guide the design?

options.text: Route 53 always terminates every old TCP connection immediately.
options.explanation: DNS tidak mengendalikan socket aplikasi yang sudah terbentuk.

options.text: Health checks automatically replicate application sessions between endpoints.
options.explanation: Health check tidak menyalin state aplikasi.

options.text: A lower TTL guarantees zero downtime for every client.
options.explanation: TTL lebih rendah membantu sebagian cache, bukan jaminan semua perilaku client.

options.text: Resolvers may retain answers until TTL expiry, and existing connections or client caches also affect failover time.
options.explanation: Perubahan jawaban DNS tidak langsung memindahkan semua koneksi aktif.

question: A Lambda consumer of Kinesis repeatedly retries a batch containing one bad record, delaying later processing. The team must isolate failures and retain failed data for investigation. Which approach is appropriate?

options.text: Increase shard count and assume the existing poison record disappears.
options.explanation: Penambahan kapasitas tidak memperbaiki record yang selalu gagal.

options.text: Disable all monitoring because retries ensure eventual correctness.
options.explanation: Retry tanpa batas dapat menghambat kemajuan hingga data melewati retention.

options.text: Return success for all records even when no processing completed.
options.explanation: Checkpoint maju sambil menghilangkan pekerjaan yang belum berhasil.

options.text: Configure supported partial-batch/bisect behavior, bounded retries or record age, and an appropriate failure destination.
options.explanation: Mekanisme ini mengurangi blokade batch; konfigurasi destination menentukan data kegagalan yang dapat diperiksa.

question: An API accepts bursty work and writes to a dependency with limited capacity. API Gateway throttling is enabled, but the dependency still needs a predictable processing rate. Which architecture best isolates the dependency?

options.text: Assume API usage-plan quotas are exact hard limits and remove worker controls.
options.explanation: Usage-plan throttling bersifat best effort, bukan jaminan batas keras bisnis.

options.text: Increase every client retry rate when throttling occurs.
options.explanation: Retry serentak dapat memperbesar beban.

options.text: Acknowledge accepted asynchronous work, buffer it durably, and limit worker concurrency with overload handling.
options.explanation: Queue dan batas worker memisahkan burst intake dari kemampuan dependency.

options.text: Scale only the public DNS service while leaving processing unbounded.
options.explanation: DNS tidak membatasi transaksi ke dependency.

question: A request crosses API Gateway, Lambda, and downstream services. Aggregate CPU metrics are normal, but users see intermittent latency. Which addition helps identify the slow dependency for individual sampled requests?

options.text: Distributed tracing with AWS X-Ray using supported instrumentation and correlation.
options.explanation: Trace menghubungkan bagian request sehingga waktu pada dependency dapat dibandingkan.

options.text: Only an S3 inventory of static website objects.
options.explanation: Inventori objek tidak melacak panggilan antarservice.

options.text: Only more frequent database backups.
options.explanation: Backup tidak mengidentifikasi titik lambat request.

options.text: Only AWS Cost Explorer grouped by service.
options.explanation: Biaya tidak menunjukkan jalur latency per request.
